pages.title: The Hungry Pickaxe
pages.text: A gold-tier pickaxe that comes pre-enchanted with Efficiency V, Fortune III and Mending. Simply holding it grants you Haste II, so tunnels melt away.

$(bold)Blood for steel$()$(br)When the Centipeck is about to break, it refuses to die: instead of losing durability it drains your own health, as long as you can survive it.$(br2)Mine with food in your pack, and repair it with Mending experience as usual.
